purpose: Read-only audit summary of explicit Human Diff Review v1.2 activity for one exact review artifact.
rules: Summaries are derived only from durable per-file reviewerId/reviewedAt metadata and the explicit acceptance event.
A session is a deterministic cluster of consecutive explicit review actions separated by less than 60 minutes; a gap of 60 minutes or more starts a new session.
Each session reports start/end timestamps, elapsed span, reviewers, file actions, finding-state counts and review-focus counts.
Elapsed span is wall-clock distance between explicit actions and is not claimed as active review duration.
Inactivity gaps are reported between sessions with exact start/end and elapsed minutes.
Acceptance is represented as its own explicit action and may form or extend a session.
The summary reports only the latest durable finding action per file because Human Diff Review v1.2 is not an event-sourced history of superseded findings.
The summary mutates nothing and never changes review, evidence, candidate, checklist or certification state.
nonClaims: Session span is not time spent actively reviewing.
A gap does not prove the reviewer was inactive outside the Defence workspace.
The summary does not reconstruct overwritten earlier findings that are not present in the durable v1.2 artifact.
Reviewer counts and finding counts are audit facts, not quality or risk scores.
